I'll compute the sum of the decimal digits of 52^12 using code to verify the result.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
# Calculate 52^12
result = 52**12
print(f"52^12 = {result}")

# Convert to string and get digits
digits = [int(d) for d in str(result)]
print(f"Digits: {digits}")

# Calculate sum of digits
digit_sum = sum(digits)
print(f"Sum of digits: {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
